answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure.
